speaker: Howard
text: I have a two-part question. A, are you kidding me? And B, seriously, are you freaking kidding me?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Go ahead. A, I rarely kid, and B, when I do kid, you will know it by my use of the word bazinga.

speaker: Howard
text: So you're saying the two of you are going to be sleeping in the same bed?

speaker: Howard
text: Why is a world-renowned scientist staying in our apartment instead of a hotel?

speaker: Sheldon
text: She doesn't care for hotels, and who can blame her? Windows that don't open, multi-user linens, keys shaped like credit cards, as if one walks around with unassigned slots in one's wallet. Alright, I believe I have time for one more question.

speaker: Howard
text: When can I sit with you again?

speaker: Sheldon
text: When I've seen two consecutive negative throat cultures spaced twelve hours apart, you know the drill. Alright, do excuse me, I am off to start a prophylactic course of antibiotics.

speaker: Howard
text: I can't believe he's friends with Elizabeth Flintin.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I can't believe they let him into Canada.

speaker: Howard
text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, you heard the man? Where's your throat cultures? Kidding. Sit down.
